relations.quote: The recursion is built on the [Three-element subset intersection construction](subset-intersection-construction.md), which gives $s<Wm$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a call, counting field digits for address interchange or selected axes for a numerical layer.
symbols.quote: Let $f$ be the parameter of a call, the number of field digits for address interchange or of selected axes for a numerical layer.

symbols.name: parameter factor
symbols.meaning: The factor by which a call's parameter is multiplied in the recursive call.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the factor by which the parameter grows; the letter changes meaning from the subspace dimension of the prerequisite.

symbols.name: normalized cost
symbols.meaning: The cost of a call at parameter f divided by the volume it works on.
symbols.quote: Let $T(f)$ be the normalized cost of a call at parameter $f$, its running time divided by the volume $V$ it works on.

symbols.name: overhead constant
symbols.meaning: The constant bounding the normalized outside work at a node.
symbols.quote: The outside work at a node of parameter $mf$ is at most $C(mf)^\lambda$, for a constant $C$ and an exponent $\lambda<1$.

symbols.name: outside-work exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent, below 1, bounding the normalized outside work at a node of parameter mf.
symbols.quote: The outside work at a node of parameter $mf$ is at most $C(mf)^\lambda$, for a constant $C$ and an exponent $\lambda<1$.
